summary.text: Chase Blasi is a Republican who has represented Kansas Senate District 26 in Sedgwick County since 2023.
He is the Senate Majority Leader and chairs the Confirmation Oversight Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Kansas Legislature profile, Blasi's spouse is McKenna Blasi.

He is vice chair of the Organization, Calendar and Rules Committee and a member of the Public Health and Welfare Committee, the Legislative Coordinating Council, the Capitol Preservation Committee and the Health Care Stabilization Fund Oversight Committee.
